name: Definition by Exhaustive Local Configurations
description: Replaces the pairwise relational definition (a 3-clique) with a property of the subset as a whole, specifying that all 8 possible local 2-colorings fail. This forces models to either deduce the pairwise equivalence (triangle) to optimize their search, or write a naive unpruned O(N^3) simulation that will fail the time limit.
